name: cascade_delete
description: In the DELETE /api/customers/:c_custkey handler, the transaction explicitly deletes child rows with `DELETE FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = ?` before deleting the parent customer with `DELETE FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = ?`. This matches the unsafe delete cascade signal because the separate read endpoint GET /api/orders depends on `orders` rows and will return missing/incomplete data after those child records are permanently removed.
